team.groupList_statusTitle_roleOccupiedByUser: You are part of the coordination team
team.group_firstSteps:
If not done already, you can start with choosing the venue and, if needed, looking for mentor(s) and then fix a date.

{COORDINATION_GUIDE}
team.group_messageInfo: Leave a message about your experience on the topic. The message will appear next to your name.
